description: Headless facade that fronts the Pins tool of NXP S32 Configuration Tools via `nxp_s32ct_execute_action(action_name="s32ct.configure_pins", params={...})`. Triggers when users ask to regenerate pin-mux source code, import existing `.c` pin definitions via `-ImportC`, apply `custom_copyright` or `output_path_overrides`, or export pin artifacts as source, CSV, HTML, registers, or MEX from a `.mex` project. Also handles bootstrapping Pins from `-EmptyConfig` with `mcu` + `sdk_version`. Delegates shared launcher plumbing (workspace `-data`, `s32ct_launcher`, `launcher_ini`, `timeout_s`, retry-on-`IllegalStateException`) to `s32ct-cli`. Keywords: pins, pin-mux, ImportC, ExportSrc, ExportCSV, ExportHTML, ExportRegisters, ExportMEX, `.mex`, `.c`.
